scripts.generate:python: python -m datamodel_code_generator --input contracts/health.schema.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --target-python-version 3.11 --enum-field-as-literal all --disable-timestamp --formatters black isort --output apps/api/src/wise_platform_api/generated/health.py && python -m datamodel_code_generator --input contracts/investigation.schema.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --target-python-version 3.11 --enum-field-as-literal all --disable-timestamp --formatters black isort --output apps/api/src/wise_platform_api/generated/investigation.py
scripts.generate:ts: json2ts --input contracts/health.schema.json --output apps/web/src/generated/health.ts && json2ts --input contracts/investigation.schema.json --output apps/web/src/generated/investigation.ts
scripts.generate: npm run generate:python && npm run generate:ts
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @wise-platform/web && tsc --noEmit -p tests/contracts/tsconfig.json && npm run test --workspace @wise-platform/web
